_about: Apuleius in English: William Adlington's Golden Asse (1566) and H. E. Butler's Apologia and Florida (Oxford, 1909), clean Gutenberg. Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives.
